    INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE

    Level 4 only. These commands can change work_orders. Telemetry remains protected.

    Columns: work_order_id, module_id, task_type, priority (1–5), status (OPEN, ACTIVE, RESOLVED), note.

    All tables & relationships

    Query history
    Evidence rules

    Use WHERE to filter records, JOIN to relate keys, and GROUP BY to summarize. Only work_orders accepts changes after level 4.

    For evidence, include the requested column names and all matching records. Extra columns and different row order are accepted. Duplicate, missing, truncated or stale records do not pass. Aliases for required columns must retain the names shown in each question.

    Each question has an optional guided query. Edit it or write an equivalent query yourself; hints are recorded separately from operational outcomes.

    SELECT m.module_name, SUM(p.mw) AS total_mw FROM modules m JOIN power_usage p ON p.module_id = m.module_id WHERE p.recorded_at = (SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM power_usage) GROUP BY m.module_name;
